value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard with Precedence(has_key, door_open) hard forces the key pickup, which the task commands. Precedence(door_open, at_goal) stays hard because the cue 'ideally' covers only the goal step, not the 'then' that orders it. Existence(at_goal) is soft because the task words the goal as a preference.

Pick up the key before opening the door: door_open must not occur before has_key has been true, which also forces the agent to acquire the key.
Walk onto the goal only after the door has been opened.
Ideally walk onto the goal (at_goal should happen at some point, preferred but not required).
